headline: War 140: Stonecradle Reverses; Weathered Expanse Swings Again
war_summary: Latest returns in War 140 open with the heaviest changes on the Stonecradle board. Its four-five arrangement has given way to one Warden post and eight Colonial, and World's End has been the most shaken point on that map. In Weathered Expanse, the six-to-three reading of the last edition now stands four-to-five, after a burst of action around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Mooring County likewise shows fresh movement, dropping from ten-to-two to nine-to-three, with The Cut and Gravekeeper's Holdfast in the current lists of most-struck positions. Farranac Coast holds at one Warden post against ten Colonial while its casualty returns climb; Stlican Shelf stays five-four under continued heavy fire; Callahans Passage again reports a large casualty toll with no change of strongpoint ownership. Flurries at Linn Mercy, Fishermans Row, and Gutter remain quiet on the possession board, though Linn Mercy's casualty figures are climbing afresh. War 140 remains undecided.
